nodes.name: Fetch Queue From GitHub
nodes.notes: Reads the manifest straight from the public repo, so the queue is edited by pushing to git — never by editing this workflow.

nodes.name: Wait 60s Between Posts
nodes.notes: Spaces the uploads out so YouTube does not see five posts in one second.

nodes.name: Send To Upload Webhook
nodes.notes: Hands each item to the existing 'Manus - Viral Shorts -> YouTube Auto Upload' workflow, which downloads the video and uploads it. That pipeline is already working and is not touched.

parameters.content:
DAILY SHORTS QUEUE

What it does, once every 24 hours:
  1. reads youtube_queue.json from the public repo
  2. picks the next 5 that have not gone out yet
  3. posts each one to the existing upload webhook, 60s apart

NOTHING OUTSIDE n8n HAS TO RUN. No laptop, no terminal, no chat session.

TO CHANGE THE QUEUE: push to the repo. This workflow re-reads it every run.
TO CHANGE THE RATE: edit PER_RUN in 'Pick Next Unposted'.
TO START OVER: clear the workflow's static data (this re-posts everything).

32 videos are queued. At 5/run that is about 6 days.
